title: Exploring Pandemic-related Stress and Resilience among Digital Workers
descriptions: Despite the COVID-19 pandemic, the world's socio-economic structure must continue to operate in the new normal for each country and its citizens to survive. Many jobs are now operating through online mode, which changed regular workers into “digital workers”. The abrupt shift in the nature of work has caused pandemic-related stress among workers and therefore begs the question - can these digital workers thrive during the pandemic? The study aims to evaluate pandemic-related stress faced by digital workers as well as their resilience to thrive during the pandemic.
